settings.display_name: KTH Google Account: Example DM text
settings.help_text: Example DM for accounts created with /keycloak migrate-to-google create-kth. {{login_instructions}} reflects the KTH-button login by default, or the existing SAML login with --keep-mamo-login-through-keycloak. Available placeholders: {{username}}, {{account}}, and {{login_instructions}}.
settings.default:
Example DM to send to the migrated user:
```text
Hi @{{username}},

Your Mattermost account has been migrated to Google account {{account}}.

{{login_instructions}}

With this account, you can access more chapter resources, including https://drive.fysiksektionen.se/ and https://mail.fysiksektionen.se/.

If you have any questions, you can DM me or get help at mattermaster@f.kth.se.

Sincerely,
The Physics Chapter Mattermost Team
```
